property_summary: For any user who previously deposited a positive amount via addToBalance, calling withdrawBalance sends them back exactly their recorded balance (address(c).balance decreases accordingly); the mutant that reads userBalance[address(0)] can send zero instead and thus breaks this invariant for some deposits and callers.
change_summary: Change the local tmp__1 to read userBalance[address(0)] instead of the caller, causing zero value to be sent and making withdraw succeed when original sent funds (observable difference when sender had balance).
